cards.ex: We arrived in Rome and immediately hit the ground running, visiting the Colosseum and the Forum.
cards.exUz: Rimga yetib keldik va darhol ishga kirishib, Kolizey va Forumga tashrif buyurdik.
cards.uzDef: Sayohatga borganda, darhol ishga kirishmoq, vaqtni behuda o'tkazmaslik.

cards.ex: Quitting my job to travel the world was a leap of faith, but I don't regret it.
cards.exUz: Ishimni tashlab dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish tavakkal qadam edi, lekin afsuslanmayman.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi noma'lum bo'lgan xavfli qarorga kelish.

cards.ex: I prefer to live like a local when I travel, trying local foods and visiting hidden spots.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilganimda, mahalliy aholi kabi yashashni afzal ko'raman, mahalliy ovqatlarni tatib ko'raman va yashirin joylarga tashrif buyuraman.
cards.uzDef: Sayohat qilayotgan joyda mahalliy aholi kabi hayot kechirish.

cards.ex: We wanted to find a restaurant off the beaten track.
cards.exUz: Biz odamlardan uzoqda joylashgan restoranni topmoqchi edik.

cards.ex: Once you get the travel bug, it's hard to stay in one place for long.
cards.exUz: Sayohatga qiziqib qolsangiz, bir joyda uzoq qolish qiyin.

cards.ex: If I won the lottery, I'd travel in style, staying in five-star hotels.
cards.exUz: Agar lotereyada yutsam, besh yulduzli mehmonxonalarda qolib, dabdabali sayohat qilardim.
cards.uzDef: Qulay va hashamatli sharoitlarda sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: After living there for a year, she started to go native, learning the language and customs.
cards.exUz: U yerda bir yil yashagandan so'ng, u mahalliy odamlarga o'xshay boshladi, til va urf-odatlarni o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi muhitga to'liq moslashish, mahalliy odatlarga ko'nikish.

cards.ex: Learning to navigate a new city is a steep learning curve, but it's also exciting.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharda yo'l topishni o'rganish qiyin jarayon, lekin u ham hayajonli.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani tez va qiyin o'rganish jarayoni.

cards.ex: We got our fill of sun and sand during our beach vacation.
cards.exUz: Biz plyaj ta'tilida quyosh va qumdan to'liq bahramand bo'ldik.

cards.ex: Even a short camping trip can give you a taste of adventure.
cards.exUz: Hatto qisqa sayohat ham sarguzasht ta'mini berishi mumkin.

cards.ex: We need to get a move on if we want to catch our train.
cards.exUz: Poyezdimizga ulgurmoqchi bo'lsak, tezroq harakat qilishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Our safari in Africa was the trip of a lifetime.
cards.exUz: Afrikadagi safari bizning hayotimizdagi eng muhim sayohat edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdagi eng muhim va unutilmas sayohat.

cards.ex: He decided to take an off-the-cuff trip to Italy.
cards.exUz: U Italiyaga tayyorgarliksiz sayohat qilishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: They spent their vacation in the lap of luxury at a private resort.
cards.exUz: Ular ta'tilini xususiy kurortda hashamat ichida o'tkazdilar.

cards.ex: I'm going to the mountains to recharge my batteries.
cards.exUz: Men kuch yig'ish uchun tog'larga ketyapman.

cards.ex: Visiting the slums was a real eye-opener for me.
cards.exUz: Uchastkalarga tashrif buyurish men uchun ko'zni ochuvchi voqea bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani tushunishga yordam beradigan voqea.

cards.ex: We didn't have a strict itinerary, we just flew by the seat of our pants.
cards.exUz: Bizda qat'iy reja yo'q edi, biz shunchaki vaziyatga qarab ish tutdik.
cards.uzDef: Rejasiz harakat qilish, vaziyatga qarab ish tutish.

cards.ex: I'm going out on a limb by suggesting we hike that mountain without a guide.
cards.exUz: Men qo'llanmasiz tog'ga chiqishni taklif qilib, tavakkal qilyapman.

cards.ex: We had to bite the bullet and pay the extra fees for our luggage.
cards.exUz: Biz yukimiz uchun qo'shimcha to'lovlarni sabr bilan qabul qilishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Noqulay vaziyatni sabr bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: We went camping to get back to nature.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiatga qaytish uchun lagerga bordik.
cards.uzDef: Tabiat bilan aloqada bo'lish, undan bahramand bo'lish.

cards.ex: He decided to take the road less traveled and explore the remote villages.
cards.exUz: U kam odam yurgan yo'lni tanlab, olis qishloqlarni o'rganishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: Traveling allows you to live life to the fullest.
cards.exUz: Sayohat qilish hayotdan maksimal darajada zavqlanib yashashga imkon beradi.

cards.ex: We have some exciting travel plans on the horizon.
cards.exUz: Bizda kelajakda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan qiziqarli sayohat rejalarimiz bor.

cards.ex: That remote island feels like it's miles away from civilization.
cards.exUz: Ushbu olis orol tsivilizatsiyadan juda uzoqda joylashganga o'xshaydi.

cards.ex: We bit off more than we could chew when we planned a 3-week trip with five kids.
cards.exUz: Biz beshta bola bilan 3 haftalik sayohatni rejalashtirganimizda, qila olmaydigan narsani qabul qildik.

cards.ex: Traffic was moving at a snail's pace due to the accident.
cards.exUz: Yo'l-transport hodisasi tufayli transport vositalari juda sekin harakatlanayotgan edi.

cards.ex: After hiking all day, we decided to call it a day and set up camp.
cards.exUz: Butun kun davomida piyoda yurganimizdan so'ng, ishimizni tugatib, lager qurishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Ishni tugatish, dam olishga vaqt ajratish.

cards.ex: I really got a lot out of visiting the museums in Florence.
cards.exUz: Men Florensiyadagi muzeylarga tashrif buyurib, ko'p narsa oldim.

cards.ex: I want to save money so I can see the world.
cards.exUz: Men dunyoni ko'rish uchun pul yig'ishni xohlayman.

cards.ex: We hit a rough patch when our car broke down in the desert.
cards.exUz: Mashinamiz cho'lda buzilib qolganda, biz qiyin davrni boshdan kechirdik.
